PHASE.NAME: CLI Build Cleanup And Release Gate
PHASE.GOAL: Resolve FIX/L2 and FIX/L6, then run the full release-quality regression gate for the issue-resolution line.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: main.rs delegates command dispatch to the CLI schema module so command ownership is localized.
Docker image build uses explicit cargo release semantics without no-op feature flags.

STEPS.step-1: Move top-level Command dispatch into the CLI module through a RunCommand-style implementation.
STEPS.step-2: Reduce main.rs to parse config, initialize tracing/runtime, and call CLI dispatch.
STEPS.step-3: Remove Dockerfile no-op --no-default-features and audit system package requirements.
STEPS.step-4: Run full issue-resolution release gates after all fixes are complete.

RISKS.RISK: Dispatch refactor is intentionally last so behavior-changing fixes are not hidden behind broad CLI movement.
